as_told.title: Beings conditioned him not to tell anyone at Vandenberg

plain: A man named Richard Barth says that in September 1964 he was a guard at a site called D5 at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, where a Minuteman nuclear missile was kept. He tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that he saw a shadow in the fog, and then a figure that looked like a man, or something humanlike, came out of it and took him. He says the being apologized and explained that they needed access to the site. He describes feeling both terror and love, and says it was too vivid and too real for anyone to have staged it. He adds that the beings seem to have conditioned or hypnotized him so he would not tell anyone at the base. Richard is the only teller, coming back to it four times in the same interview, each time adding a detail, and it is linked to his story of a craft taking down a dummy warhead. If true, it would mean nonhuman beings were entering American nuclear sites in the 1960s.
